note: Evil Mode slice 17 (design Part 11): the mole. One of four handlers is rolled at the run's start on the stream evil-mole; from District 2 of the first region one applicant is marked (a second a district on if the first is turned away, a third a region on; refuse all three and there's no mole). The mole is a field in the block's hidden state, never on a card. Kice's answer 7: the mole is on. With "on" false, every evil-mole draw is still taken and nothing it decides is used: the streets are the same. Numbers are starting values, not playtested.
patron: The Patron, at the first Arrival: "There's always somebody. In my day it was me."

police: Twelve on strength. Three squads daily. Vault is the second door past the kitchen. The kitchen is better run than the Vault.
Subject pays wages on the day. This is unusual and I am noting it because it will come up when you ask them to turn on each other. They won't.
They frightened a shopkeeper this week. The squad came back quiet. Noting it.
They have a Pen. It is empty. Somebody let everything out. Nobody has disciplined anyone for it.
You asked for the leader's weakness. I've been here a region. It's that they go themselves. Every time it matters, they go themselves.
I'd like to be relieved. Not because it's dangerous. Because I've started covering the late shift so the driver can see his mother, and I don't think that's in my brief.
neighbour: Thursday, the quarry, two squads. The big one and the one who talks. Be ready or be elsewhere.
Funds about four thousand. They're broke more often than you'd think. They keep paying people.
They leaned on a street this week. Three of them went. Expect more of it.
You asked if they could be bought out. No. I offered the driver double, like you said. He told the cook. The cook gave me soup and said I looked tired.
Pay me. It's been two weeks. They pay on the day here. I'm just saying.
I'm not sending Friday's. Send somebody else if you want Friday's.
local: They're coming Thursday. Three of them. One's all right.
Don't open the door to the tall one. He's not cruel. He just does what he's told.
They leaned on a man in a shop again, Dad. The same ones who came to you.
It's the same ones who came to you. They went back to Mrs. Eze's and mended her step. The same ones.
I've not got anything this week. They've not done anything this week I'd warn you about.
I think you'd like the old bookkeeper. Don't look at me like that.
mother: Dear Mrs. —, I'm in. They're not what the paper says. They're not not what the paper says either. I'll write properly Sunday.
There's a woman here who was a ward sister. She treated a constable last week, on the kitchen table. Nobody stopped her.
They frightened a man in a shop on Tuesday. I was there. I'm not proud of it. I'm telling you because you asked for the truth and that's part of it.
Your one came through on the road today. Our lot were told to leave them be. I saw the order. It was underlined.
You asked what the Boss is like. Tired. Polite. Goes themselves when it's something bad. I don't know what that tells you. It tells me something.
I think when it comes to it they'll talk before they fight. I think. Tell them to listen, if it's offered.

fedLabel: The other lot were somewhere else.

tells.1: A job failed with them on it.
tells.2: Asked a question at Night they shouldn't have known to ask.
tells.6: Too good. Nothing's gone wrong for them all region.

screen.title: Suspicions
screen.help: Nothing here is proof. Slips are pinned by the date they were seen. Pick a card, then Name them or Feed them a false job.
screen.table: Jobs, by who was on them
screen.name: Name them
screen.feedRefuses: {name} won't be named on a job that's a lie to the Roster.

fed.nothing: The false job sat on the Board all day. Nobody came. Nothing moved.
fed.police: The law raided an empty warehouse at dawn. Heat −3. Somebody's been reprimanded.
fed.neighbour: The other lot were at the quarry all night, waiting. The next real job's easier.
fed.local: A street braced all day for a Lean that never came. It's an unkind thing to do to a frightened street.
fed.mother: Nothing happened. A false job isn't a thing the team did.

found.police: "Ask me about Looker." A breath. "No? Then I'll save you the trouble. Yes. Since the second week. You're a tidier outfit than most I've been in, and tidy's what gets a case to court."
found.neighbour: "It was money. I'm not going to dress it. They pay ₽300 a day and you pay ₽150 and I've a mother. … You pay on the day, though. They don't."
found.local: "You sent people into my father's shop. He picked the jar up off the floor. I watched him pick it up. I wanted to see the face of whoever sent that. … I've seen it. I don't know what you are."
found.mother: "I'm not a spy. She asked me to look, so I'm looking. She's a mum. She can't sleep. I write to her on Sundays and tell her what you had for tea. You can read all of them."

wrong.scene: {name} is called in. You say it. They deny it, truthfully, and it sounds the same as a lie would.
wrong.minor: {name} doesn't deny it. She doesn't say anything. She's gone by morning, without her pay. Hortense, at breakfast: "What did you say to that child?"

acts.keep: Say nothing, and let them stay

police.ask: "What's it for? Not the speech. What's it for."
police.no: "Then I've nothing to work with. I'll be gone by morning."
police.yes: "If I told you to stop one thing. One. {method}. Would you?" You say yes. They stay police, and file what's true.
police.stop: Stopped, for the region, at the mole's asking.

neighbour.yes: "…And I just tell them what you say. I'd have done it for less. You pay on the day." ₽300 a day.
neighbour.no: Not enough Funds to pay ₽300 a day.

local.yes: "Don't tell me. Do it. Or don't. I'll know by Thursday which, because I'll hear it from him."

mother.no: "I'm not spying. She asked me to look. I'm looking. You can't change what I write except by changing what there is to write about."

turn.rebought: {name} took the other lot's better offer. The next job against them is expected again.
turn.refusedOffer: {name}, at Night: "They said six hundred. I said I'd think. I've thought."

police.fair: "I'm going to file that I found nothing I could charge. It'll be nearly true. Don't make it less true after I've gone."
police.mixed: "You're two outfits. One pays wages and mends steps. One stands in shops. I don't know which one I'm reporting on. Neither do you."
police.hard: "I've been in six of these. You're not the worst. I want you to hear how little that is."

neighbour.fair: "They're going to lose to you. I'll tell them why and they won't believe me. It's the soup."
neighbour.mixed: "You're the same as them with better manners. The manners are worth something. Not as much as you think."
neighbour.hard: "I took their money to watch you. I'd have done it free. I learned more about how not to."

local.fair: "I came to see who'd send people to do that. I've seen. It was somebody who'd also send people to put it right. I'm going home to tell him both."
local.mixed: "I still don't know what you are. I'm going home anyway."
local.hard: "I watched you for two months waiting for the bit where it turned out you had a reason. Thank you for letting me go. That's the first thing."

mother.fair: "I'll tell her you opened the door. She'll want to know that more than anything else I've written."
mother.mixed: "I'll tell her the truth. It's long. She'll read it twice."
mother.hard: "I'm going to tell her to tell them not to come. They'll come anyway. They're that sort. So were you, I think, once."

lines: A knock. It's somebody you've had no reason to think about.
"Have you a minute? I've something to tell you and I'd like to get to the end of it before you say anything."
"I was sent. I've been reporting since my second week. I stopped three weeks ago. I've decided stopping isn't enough, so here I am."
"I'm not asking to stay. I'm telling you because people here have been saving me the end of the loaf, and I couldn't sit at that table another night with it not said."
knock.stay: They stay. They tell whoever sent them they're out.
knock.tell: They tell the Hall. Somebody says "We knew," and nobody did.
knock.go: They go. The Roster's told they left.
knock.nothing: "Right. I'll be in the Mess." It's never mentioned again.

poached: {name}'s gone over to the other lot. They offered double. They'll be on the other side of the next job, with the kit you gave them.
ran: {name}'s bunk is empty. They knew they'd been made.
sentLeft: {name} goes. On the way out, one thing:
